limitations.details: 正文無品質改善保證，兩路不混成同一實驗；固定參考不是正確答案老師，候選排序不代表自由生成。數字只屬指定既存作者環境；CPU feasibility與學生電腦時間仍未測。CPU小模型單步、既存資料解包及原JSON重算只證機制/格式；未訓練正式recipe、未teacher/final/GPU/Modal/付費/發布。正文要求保留內容/格式/安全回歸檢查，未把它說成已通過。

review_scope.frozen_body_lines: 1–54 including details and every shell command

review_scope.not_performed: 200-step student recipe; fixed research training/evaluation; teacher or final forward; GPU/Modal/paid operations; publication; website rendering; human student test
